title: Section Header
description: The centred cluster that opens a section: an optional Script Accent line, a Section Title heading, and a short intro paragraph, held to the content measure and centred as a group. It carries no rule of its own — the gold rule belongs to the Section Title heading inside it, which is how the live site draws it (`.lsx-title:after`). The previous KWV version put a 1px brand border along the bottom of the group; the live site has no such border anywhere, so it was removed rather than recoloured.
